mainEntity.name: What does it really cost to run a chief-of-staff AI system with multiple bots?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs can include the AI platform, specialized tools, automation or integration services, storage, communication systems, and human review time. The prompt library itself does not eliminate those supporting costs or guarantee that an assistant can perform an action. Run My AI Business lists a free starting option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter subscription for full weekly issues, while the separately promoted mastermind and its resources should be evaluated on their own terms. Before committing, calculate the cost per completed workflow, including revisions and failed runs. Compare that with the value of time saved, faster delivery, improved consistency, or better decision preparation—not with an assumed revenue outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Budget for the AI platform, connected tools, automation services, storage, and your review time. Run My AI Business lists a free starting option and a $9 monthly paid newsletter subscription, but other resources and tools may have separate costs. Compare total cost per completed workflow with measurable time or quality improvements.
